Washington's longest running drag show is back and this time your love life gets a dress code. 🚦💋

Vida Amore y sus Divas return to the Ranchero Room with the Fiesta Semáforo — pulsera roja si estás ocupade, amarilla si es complicado, verde si estás libre. DJ ShaReal's on the boards all night, the Divas own the stage, and your wristband tells the whole room your status before you even open your mouth. 🟥🟨🟩

Pick your color. Pick your chaos. Pasco's never seen a drag night with this much flirting built in.

🗓️ Saturday, Nov 21 • Doors 8:30pm | Show 9:30pm
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $20
🔞 21+

#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #VidaAmoreDivas #FiestaSemaforo #DragShow #TriCities #Pasco #StopLightParty

Red light glowing off sequins, green light flashing by the bar, yellow light making somebody's night complicated. 🚦✨

Feel the Ranchero Room fill up with wristbands of every color before Vida Amore y sus Divas even hit the stage. DJ ShaReal's bass thumping through the floor, heels hitting the stage like thunder, the whole room reading each other's colors before a word gets said. 💃🏽🎤

Sticky drinks, sweet tension, a show that's been running longer than almost anyone in this state can remember.

🗓️ Saturday, Nov 21 • Doors 8:30pm | Show 9:30pm

Ocupade, quizás, or libre — wear your color and let the Ranchero Room do the rest. 🚦💕

Vida Amore y sus Divas bring Fiesta Semáforo to Azúcar, and this crowd comes exactly as honest as the wristband says. Red if you're taken, yellow if it's complicated, green if you're free — no judgment, just vibes, drinks, and a drag show that's been Washington's longest running for a reason. 💄🎶

Come single, come taken, come confused — the floor's got room for every color tonight.

Mark it down — Fiesta Semáforo hits the Ranchero Room this Saturday and the wristbands do the talking. 🚦📋

Vida Amore y sus Divas headline Washington's longest running drag show with DJ ShaReal keeping the whole night moving. Grab your color at the door — red, yellow, or green — and let the room know exactly where you stand. Table reservations go through @vidaamore, @alyanaamore, or @vidaamoredivasshow if you want your spot locked in before doors. 🟥🟨🟩

Doors early, show sharp, cover's light, energy's not.
